source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Compare the inspection records to the architectural plan.
3. Check the integrity of the fire-safety systems.
4. Record any defects or issues found in the documentation.
5. Take pictures of any defects or issues found for evidence.
6. Identify potential fire hazards in the building.
7. Conduct a fire-safety risk assessment.
8. Document the findings in detail along with recommendations.
9. Communicate the findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
10. Verify the implementation of any corrective action recommended.
